title_candidates: NVIDIA puts a 4B world model on edge hardware
summary: Cosmos 3 Edge is a compact world model for understanding scenes, predicting outcomes, and generating actions on NVIDIA robotics and vision hardware.

primary_source.title: Introducing Cosmos 3 Edge
primary_source.author: NVIDIA and Hugging Face
key_facts: Cosmos 3 Edge is a four-billion-parameter world model for robotics and vision systems on NVIDIA edge hardware.
It connects scene understanding and future prediction with action generation.
NVIDIA reports 32 actions per inference at 15 updates per second for its Jetson Thor robot-policy setup.
The release includes model files, checkpoints, and training resources on Hugging Face.

supporting_sources.title: Cosmos3-Edge model card
key_facts: The model card lists commercial and non-commercial use under OpenMDW 1.1, global deployment, supported modalities, and developer-focused setup resources.

prerequisites: A proposed robotics or vision task

steps.instruction: Match the task's inputs and outputs to the model card.
Check the license and supported hardware before downloading files.
Plan an offline recorded-data evaluation before any live control test.

risk_flags: The release is intended for specialist NVIDIA hardware and should not be presented as a consumer local model.
Live robot control requires a separate safety process.
